title: Japanese Red Bean Pilaf
description: A simple and comforting Japanese-inspired pilaf made with red beans, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Dutch red kidney beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the Dutch red kidney beans, uncooked Japanese short-grain rice, and warm water to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Stir in the buttery soy sauce and season with salt to taste.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
